annotations.title: Quote a boiler or air conditioning installation

description: Work out Renzy's fixed, fully fitted price for a new gas boiler or air conditioning in Greater London. Call it with the product and every answer so far. A postcode is optional: prices don't use it. If you pass one outside Greater London, this returns needs_a_call straight away. While questions remain it returns them with their options, to ask the customer in order. Questions depend on earlier answers, so call it again after each round. Once all are answered it returns each option's itemised price, the extras and the installation dates on offer. If the home can't be priced online it says why and how to reach Renzy. Read-only: it does not place an order or contact the customer.

answers.description: The customer's answers so far, as question id to option value, using the ids and values quote_installation returned. Leave it out to start.

postcode.description: Optional. Postcode of the home, e.g. SW6 1AA. Prices don't need it. Outside Greater London, the result is needs_a_call.

product.description: boiler for a new gas boiler, air-conditioning for air conditioning
